label: GOD_4 incorruptibility controls, checked (inference)
rule: Explicit one- and two-being interpretations checked by case analysis and simp
meaning: Controls for the GOD_4 incorruptibility composition: a nonvacuity witness with a GOD_4 instance; for each of the three premises an interpretation in which the other two hold and some GOD_4 being can fail to be (so each premise is needed); and an interpretation in which GOD_4 is simply incorruptible but not NECESSARY_1 in the tertia via's sense. Model-witnessed facts about these interpretations only; no interpretation is claimed metaphysically possible.
